plugins.name: sage300-assistant
plugins.description: Sage 300 (Accpac) ERP assistant: verified T-SQL from AOM data dictionaries, version/upgrade guidance and release notes, and C# against the ACCPAC.Advantage .NET library.

plugins.name: sapb1-assistant
plugins.description: SAP Business One (B1) ERP assistant: object type number, table and primary key lookup from a bundled list of all B1 object types, verified SQL views/queries from bundled B1 10.0 and 9.3 data dictionaries, and C# development against the DI API from a bundled DI API 10.0 class and enum reference. More capabilities to follow.

plugins.name: team-comms
plugins.description: Personal writing assistant for short, clear team and work emails: drafts, polishes, and replies in a simple, warm, plain-English voice with hard length limits.
